title: Graco Expands Global Investment in Customer Training and Expertise

## Graco Expands Global Investment in Customer Training and Expertise


**New EMEA Application and Process Innovation Center in Belgium strengthens Graco’s worldwide commitment to helping customers test, learn and optimize products and solutions.**


For over a century, Graco has continuously focused on innovation and solutions that help customers move the materials that matter most to them. But the company’s innovation doesn’t stop the moment a product leaves the factory, it continues until customers, distributors and employees understand how to use the products effectively.


That’s why Graco continues to invest in product training, application centers and other learning opportunities around the globe. These resources provide access to product information, Graco experts, as well as areas where users can test products, validate processes, and learn how to get the most from the equipment.


The latest example of this investment is Graco’s new EMEA Application and Process Innovation Center in Maasmechelen, Belgium. Designed to support customer projects through validation, the new center provides a dedicated environment with multiple testing areas where users can assess Graco equipment, validate materials and refine automation strategies for sealant, adhesive, coating, electronics and hygienic ingredient transfer applications.


Together, in addition to the existing Liquid Finishing Center in Maasmechelen, these facilities provide a comprehensive environment for exploring a wide range of Graco's industrial solutions.


#### Learning through hands-on experience


In addition to its application centers scattered around the globe, Graco offers instructor-led trainings designed to help distributors and other users strengthen their product knowledge through lectures, demonstrations and testing opportunities.


This hands-on approach helps users:


-


Train operators and technical teams


-


Identify solutions tailored to specific application challenges


-


Gain confidence with new technologies


-


Stay current on products, technology and techniques


By combining lectures with hands-on product training, Graco is helping users move beyond product selection and toward long-term success.


#### Continued investment in product education and success


The new EMEA Application and Process Innovation Center reinforces Graco’s continued investment in customer-focused experiences and success. Together, with Graco’s global offering for trainings and resources, this facility gives customers and distributors another way to learn about products, test applications and gain the confidence needed to successfully use and implement products into various applications and operations.


[Learn more](https://www.graco.com/us/en/about-graco/locations.html) about where Graco’s training facilities are located and[get access](https://www.graco.com/us/en/support/product-training.html) to Graco’s on-demand product training resources.
